name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

lean.basis: Democratic congresswoman from New York since 2019 and member of the Democratic Socialists of America; the leading voice of the party's progressive wing.

current_role: U.S. representative for New York's 14th district (since 2019)
summary: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez has represented parts of the Bronx and Queens in Congress since 2019 and is the most prominent progressive of her generation. She toured with Bernie Sanders on the 2025 Fighting Oligarchy tour, helped elect Zohran Mamdani as New York mayor, and is weighing a 2028 presidential or Senate run, with an operation staffed largely by Sanders alumni.
